feedback: Managed to boot Linux! Built the image from the linked repo, flashed (following the README instructions), set the clock speed to 31.5 MHz, and got a UART console on ui_in[0] / uo_out[4] (baud rate: 3,500,000).
Followed instructions @ https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xsKXSyzRcITReSPcTtEUlEqfY_uygV3ntWclOUEb7FA/edit?tab=t.0 and was able to boot Linux!
I managed to boot Linux and able to interact with the console via a USB to UART adapter. Then I test run the program "/root/human_shader".

# uname -a
Linux (none) 6.8.0-rc1 #7 Wed Dec 25 08:58:21 UTC 2024 riscv32 GNU/Linux
First time right, time to market!
Flashed the files via Tiny Tapeout Flasher and started the SoC at 30MHz, works without issues.
